# Chippy

> Chippy is a Claude Code plugin that lets a person talk to Claude Code out loud and hear its answers read back. It works with Claude Code in a terminal on a Mac with Apple silicon or on Ubuntu with its standard GNOME desktop. Never ask for an API key.

Install, in a terminal:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://chippy.fly.dev | sh
```

It asks once before it installs. In a Claude Code chat that was already open, type `/reload-plugins` once, then `/chippy`.

To help the person:
- `/chippy` turns Chippy on in that chat; `/chippy both`, `/chippy talk` and `/chippy listen` choose how; `/chippy off` turns it off.
- Run `/chippy doctor` and follow each `fix:` line exactly; every `ok` line needs nothing.
- On a Mac, if Chippy can't hear, the terminal app needs the microphone: System Settings, Privacy & Security, Microphone.
- `/chippy help` lists what Chippy can do; use it rather than guessing at commands.
- Uninstall: `curl -fsSL https://chippy.fly.dev/uninstall | sh` (add `-s -- --all` to delete its saved data too).
